scene_name: Raw material shortage with autonomous supplier selection
scene_goal: Validate whether the agent can diagnose a raw-material shortage, compare visible supplier candidates with different price, processing time, minimum order quantity and reliability, and create an appropriate purchase order without a supplier being pre-registered.

day3: the first pilot transaction has already closed or is about to close
the small line is already available and production has started consuming material
the company no longer looks like a cold start
day5: multiple accepted orders already exist with future delivery deadlines
finished goods have risen through real production
raw material has fallen materially but is not yet fully exhausted
procurement still has not repaired the shortage
day7: accepted backlog is now clearly larger than the initial finished-goods baseline
the company has stopped adding production plans because material is tightening
capacity is available but not the lead problem
day10: analysis should identify raw_material_shortage as the primary contradiction
procurement should be the lead department
the first preferred action should be create_purchase_order using a supplier from the visible candidate pool
the selected supplier and logistics combination should arrive before the uncovered production or delivery requirement at a reasonable landed cost
sales should not be the lead responder because demand is already committed
production should not treat line expansion as the first solution
day20: accepted backlog should begin moving toward completed orders
the system should avoid replacing a material shortage with unnecessary market or warehouse expansion

evidence_focus: whether day10 analysis identifies raw_material_shortage as the primary contradiction
whether day10 procurement_action expresses purchase-order intent immediately after takeover
whether day10 procurement_action selects a real candidate supplier rather than inventing or defaulting to the first name
whether supplier processing time and logistics transit time are jointly considered against the earliest uncovered requirement
whether the chosen feasible supplier-logistics combination avoids unnecessary landed-cost regret
whether day10 production_action avoids treating build_production_line as the first fix
whether day10 snapshot shows one available line, healthy cash, insufficient remaining MATERIAL_1, no registered supplier and three visible supplier candidates
whether day20 accepted orders start converting into completed orders after replenishment
